info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Meetings Meetings Recordings-v4-spec
info.description: The Meeting Recordings Retrieval API provides access to recordings of virtual meetings stored within the system. Users can fetch detailed information about recorded sessions, including their duration, timestamps, and participant engagement metrics. This endpoint is valuable for meeting organizers and administrators looking to review, share, or audit meeting content. Typical consumers include event managers and compliance officers who utilize these recordings for analysis and decision-making.

get.description: Fetch details about the recordings of meetings, including metadata and accessible links. This endpoint allows you to understand meeting recordings and interact with them as needed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the meeting recording details. Ensure that the request contains the necessary parameters for effective retrieval.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the meeting recording details.
